_comment: First-time hint cards (scripts/feature_hints.gd): shown once per player the first time a feature opens, with a looping clip of it being done (assets/tutorial/clips/<clip>.ogv) and its keys. guide: the Field guide card for more.

site_plan.title: The site plan
site_plan.text: A top-down view of your site. Pick a part from the bar at the bottom, then drag on the ground to lay out rooms, or click to place machines.

interior.title: Furnishing a room
interior.text: You furnish the room you're standing in, in first person. The bar shows what fits this room; aim where it should go and click.

carrying.title: Carrying things
carrying.text: A ghost shows where it will go: green fits. Put it on the floor, a table, a shelf or a bunk.

rover.title: Driving the rover
rover.text: The hangar door opens as you drive up. Watch the battery: a reserve gets you home, and the rover charger in the bay can call it back.

mission_control.title: Mission Control
mission_control.text: Messages from Earth, your crew, the alert log and the Field guide, which explains every system.

shielding.title: Shielding
shielding.text: Radiation shielding goes on the outside walls and roofs, and protects the whole habitat. Insulation goes on inside walls, and quietens the room.

alerts.title: When something goes wrong
alerts.text: ARDEN doesn't interrupt: an icon appears at the top of the screen, blue, amber or red. Click it (or press N) to hear what's wrong and what to do. Right-click hides it until it gets worse.
